{{Quote|Warning: This is an Imperial News Network emergency alert. There are increasing reports of rakghoul plague outbreak in Imperial space and bordering systems. The infection rate is growing exponentially. Officials indicate the death toll exceeds ten thousand, with many infected still at large. Anyone mutated by the rakghoul plague represents an extreme threat. For your own safety, interstellar travel has been restricted by the Ministry of Logistics.|An [[Imperial News Network (Sith Empire)|Imperial News Network]] bulletin|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''rakghoul pandemic''' was a massive outbreak of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] that occurred around a decade after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
===Tatooine Outbreak===
[[File:Rakghoul_outbreak.png|thumb|left|220px|An infected [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a [[Rakghoul]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
The pandemic began after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] known as the ''[[Stardream]]'' crashed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The cruiser carried with it an animal infected with the plague, which ultimately spread to the other passengers and crew. The ship was disabled over the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet and crashed into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]],<ref name="Codex 1" /> from whence the survivors spread across the planet, infecting tribes of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and native fauna.<ref name="Codex 3">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakghoul Pandemic: 3 – Outbreak on Tatooine}}</ref> The deadly disease also spread into highly populated areas, including [[Mos Ila]] and [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], prompting officials from both the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to initiate a quarantine of the planet and implement travel restrictions across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Despite these efforts, tenacious adventurers traveled to and from Tatooine, working to stem the spread of the virus but simultaneously carrying it further from the source. This prompted quarantine teams to intercept infected individuals boarding both Republic and Imperial space stations.

The Tatooine crisis was notable in the creation of [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization|THORN]], as the children of its founder [[Addalar Hyland]] lost their lives during the incident, motivating the wealthy CEO to invest in battling the disease.<ref name="codex-THORN" />

===Alderaan Rakghoul Resurgence===
[[File:Triage_tent.png|thumb|right|200px|A field hospital on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the Rakghoul Pandemic.]]
Some time later, an outbreak of the Rakghoul plague was reported on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TOR-Alderaan">{{TORcite|Featured Event: Rakghoul Plague Outbreak on Alderaan}}</ref> Initially reported on [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] as unexplained animal attacks,<ref name="Rak1">{{Twitter|SWTOR|status/422767675652067328|[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|The Old Republic]]|quote=Strange animal attacks have been reported by soldiers serving on Alderaan. An investigation is currently underway.|archivedate=20200526012416}}</ref> the build up of [[Galactic Solutions Industries|G.S.I.]] armaments,<ref name="Rak2">{{Twitter|SWTOR|status/423172783682494464|[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|The Old Republic]]|quote=Shipments of GSI goods/personnel to Alderaan increasing significantly. Cargo manifests unavailable for review at this time.|archivedate=20200526012418}}</ref> THORN operatives<ref name="Rak3">{{Twitter|SWTOR|status/424278547297869824|[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|The Old Republic]]|quote=Unconfirmed reports describe armed GSI personnel and others in uniforms marked "THORN" operating in Alderaanian cities and spaceports.|archivedate=20160104074219}}</ref> and several meetings between [[Addalar Hyland]] and Alderaanian officials on the planet<ref name="Rak4">{{Twitter|SWTOR|status/423117509856731136|[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|The Old Republic]]|quote=Details of meetings between GSI CEO Addalar Hyland and members of the Alderaanian nobility remain scarce. Are new arms deals in the works?|archivedate=20200526012417}}</ref> indicated otherwise. THORN issued an official level-2 emergency alert and quarantines was put in place to restrict traffic of the plague off-world.<ref name="TOR-web">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20140122|text=EMERGENCY ALERT: Rakghoul Plague Outbreak on Alderaan – AVOID ALDERAAN!}}</ref>

In the context of the [[Alderaan Civil War]], [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] cited the outbreak's epicenter near [[King's Pass]] as an evidence that [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] conspired to use the plague as a bioweapon, while House Thul claimed House Organa implemented the plague to blame them. Nevertheless, [[House Ulgo]] was also suspected in releasing the plague, so as to raise tension between those Houses and weaken them for Ulgo's eventual conquest.<ref name="codex-Alderaan">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakghouls on Alderaan}}</ref> Given the conflict's nature, the true source of the spread of the disease may never come to light. Despite this, THORN recruited qualified volunteer emergency responders to travel to affected areas to combat the spread of the plague in the newly discovered [[rakghoul tunnels]].<ref name="TOR-Alderaan" />

[[File:THORN_Crisis_Command.png|thumb|left|250px|The THORN Crisis Command in the [[rakghoul tunnels]].]]

THORN officials [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aleea Ressel]] and [[Tralie Masoon]] were dispatched to organize Republic and Imperial volunteers in [[Thul Palace]] and [[Castle Organa]].<ref name="TOR-Alderaan" /> The volunteers were first tasked to battle through [[plague bearer]]s, who were maddened by the infection and attacked anyone in sight. Getting through the mind-addled citizens, the volunteers then vaccinated infected people still in the early stages of the disease.<ref name="QHO">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[DAILY] Quarantine: House Organa|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="QHT">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[DAILY] Quarantine: House Thul|Alderaan}}</ref> After which the volunteers were sent into the aforementioned underground tunnels in [[King's Pass]], descending with the help [[The Spike (weapon)|the Spike]]. In order to reduce tensions between Imperial and Republic forces, the volunteers were either assigned to [[Operations Command Center]] for Imperials or [[Crisis Command Center]] for the Republic.<ref name="TOR-Alderaan" /> The volunteers would then be given various tasks, namely, capturing rakghouls born within the tunnels rather than through infection called [[rakling]]s,<ref name="RUR2">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[DAILY] Rounding Up Raklings|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="CR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[DAILY] Collecting Raklings|Alderaan}}</ref> investigating artifacts of rakghoul culture,<ref name="AGE">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[DAILY] A Grim Examination|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="ATR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[DAILY] All That Remains|Alderaan}}</ref> collecting mutagenic samples from recently infected [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and [[Joiner]]s,<ref name="TtP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[DAILY] Tracking the Plague|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="DtP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[DAILY] Dissecting the Plague|Alderaan}}</ref> reconnecting navigational markers sent out by the Spike to map the tunnels,<ref name="NtT">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[DAILY] Navigating the Tunnels|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="TTN">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[DAILY] The Tunnel Network|Alderaan}}</ref> acquiring tissue samples from newly discovered fungal rakghouls<ref name="FaF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[HEROIC 4] Flora and Fauna|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="FG">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[HEROIC 4] Fungal Corruption|Alderaan}}</ref> and the primary goal of culling the rakghoul population.<ref name="AGE" /><ref name="ATR" /> After gaining the trust and prestige of THORN, groups of volunteers were recruited to hunt down massive rakghouls called the [[Eyeless]] in their [[Lair of the Eyeless|lairs]]<ref name="TRN">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[OPS] The Rakghoul Nightmare|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="HoI">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[OPS] Heart of Infection|Alderaan}}</ref>.

Additional tunnels were found on Tatooine, around the crash of the ''Stardream, ''<ref name="codex-Tatooine">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakghouls on Tatooine}}</ref> and in the [[Labor Valley]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="codex-Corellia">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakghouls on Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The outbreak of the Rakghoul pandemic was an event in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which began on [[April 15]], [[2012]]. The Alderaan Rakghoul Resurgence Event then started on [[January 21]] until [[January 28]], [[2014]].
